fact: The Minister's April 2026 budget speech says the Ministry coordinates and oversees the Digital Economy Strategy 2024-2034 and has built an electronic system for tracking each indicator's progress, and reports implementation only through infrastructure outputs, with no progress shown against the strategy's own targets.
